caption:
What time do you usually decide what's for dinner? Comment the time.

One decision a week instead of seven evening ones: WE.LIFE gives you a 7-day meal plan and shows today's meals right on the home screen. In the morning you already know what's for dinner and whether to buy anything.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Images in this video are AI-generated illustrations.

#mealplan #dinnerideas #mealprep
